per_rule.rule: S_N should be unique within Acc_Info_dirty because it functions as a join key and is described as a one-to-one shared key.
Every S_N value in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N.
Account_No must be stored as a 4-digit text code containing exactly four digits.
Account_No should be unique per account record.
Full_Name should not contain obvious casing anomalies such as all-lowercase name parts, except for known lowercase particles like 'bin', 'binte', 'd/o', and 's/o'.
For the same S_N, Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty should represent the same person as Cust_Bio_dirty.Name after normalising case and spacing differences.
ID must follow the dominant identifier format: one letter, followed by 7 digits, ending with one letter.
ID must be unique across account records.
JoinDate must not be null.
JoinDate must be a parseable datetime value in the approved account join-date format.
JoinDate must not be in the future.
LastLogin must be a parseable datetime in the observed 19-character timestamp format.
JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin.
Subscription_Type must be one of the approved subscription tiers: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, or Premium.
SubscriptionFee must not be null.
SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric amount.
If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0 or null after numeric standardisation.
Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
AccountBalance must not use the explicit sentinel value 99999.0.
AccountBalance should not be negative.
PreferredLanguage must be one of the approved observed languages: English, French, German, Malay, or Tamil.
Device must be one of Desktop, Mobile, or Tablet.
OS must use canonical operating-system names: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, or macOS.
FeedbackScore must be between 1 and 5 inclusive.
FeedbackScore1 must be between 1 and 5 inclusive.
FeedbackScore and FeedbackScore1 should match exactly for the same record.
If Full_Name contains 'Bin' or 's/o', the linked Cust_Bio_dirty.Gender for the same S_N must be Male; if it contains 'Binte' or 'd/o', the linked Gender must be Female.
For the same S_N, Acc_Info_dirty.ID should match Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No exactly.
FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel placeholder values
